description:
About the role
Thistlewood Animal Hospital is a small-animal practice looking for a Registered Veterinary Technician to join our surgical ward.

Responsibilities
- Monitor anesthesia and vital signs during surgery
- Perform venipuncture, place intravenous catheters, and give medications
- Take dental and full-body radiographs
- Restrain dogs and cats safely during examinations
- Counsel pet owners on post-operative care

Requirements
- Current Registered Veterinary Technician (RVT) license
- 2+ years of clinical experience in a small-animal hospital
- Experience monitoring anesthesia
- Proficiency in venipuncture and catheter placement
- Able to lift 50 pounds and stand for a full shift

Preferred qualifications
- Experience with dental radiography
- Experience with exotic species
- Experience in emergency and critical care
